submission.failed_boundary: The provider transport timed out: the request was sent but the response was lost (TimeoutError 'Response lost; remote transfer outcome is unknown' raised from the transport in app/adapters.py), after the intent and reservation had been committed.
submission.evidence: incident/stderr.txt traceback (TimeoutError from app/adapters.py send); incident/ledger.db balances available=50000 reserved=50000, payments row milestone-42 with transfer_id NULL, postings 0; app/core.py pay() order: prepare, then transfers.create.
submission.external_outcome: Unknown: the provider may or may not have created the transfer. No transfer id is available to the application.
submission.local_state: Payment row present with transfer_id NULL; 50000 cents reserved; no posting; available 50000.
submission.reproduction: Start from a fresh ledger with 100000 cents. Wire the timeout fixture (app/fixtures/timeout.json) as the transport and run the payment. Assert exit status 1 with TimeoutError in stderr, reserved == 50000, postings == 0, transfer_id NULL, and that the request matched the fixture request.
submission.recovery: Keep the reservation. Within the 23-hour window, retry with the same payment_id and idempotency key contractor-payment:milestone-42 so the provider deduplicates; or reconcile by querying the provider for that idempotency key before retrying. Never release the reserved funds or use a new key.
